trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
1. Earn every other trophy in this list to complete the set.
2. Work through all six roadmap stages in order.
3. The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
1. Start a new game; the prologue mission Gone Fishing begins automatically.
2. Follow Lucia and Jason through the opening beats.
3. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
1. Progress the main story through every mission of Chapter 1.
2. Keep playing the chapter's missions in the listed order.
3. Unlocks as the Chapter 1 finale rolls.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Move on to Chapter 2 after Chapter 1 finishes.
2. Complete all Chapter 2 story missions.
3. The trophy unlocks at the end of Chapter 2.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Continue the main story into Chapter 3.
2. Complete each Chapter 3 story mission in order.
3. Trophy pops as Chapter 3 concludes.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. Push the main story into Chapter 4.
2. Finish all Chapter 4 story missions.
3. Unlocks at the Chapter 4 finale.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
1. Reach the final story mission after Chapter 4.
2. Complete the last mission of the campaign.
3. This gold trophy unlocks on mission completion.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Advance the main story until Breakfast Run becomes available.
2. Complete the mission's objectives.
3. Unlocks on mission completion.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description; Exophase trophy page.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
1. Progress the story to The Cartel Heist.
2. Survive the heist and complete its objectives.
3. Trophy pops once the heist wraps up.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Reach the Child's Play mission in the story.
2. Complete the mission's objectives.
3. Unlocks on completion.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Advance to the Headliners mission.
2. Finish the mission set.
3. Trophy unlocks at the end.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. Reach the VCIA Takedown mission.
2. Complete the mission's objectives.
3. Unlocks on completion.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
1. Advance to Operation Savage Glory.
2. Finish the mission's objectives.
3. Trophy pops at mission end.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
1. Finish every story and stranger mission strand.
2. Complete all activities and challenges.
3. Gather every collectible across the state.
4. The counter hits 100% on the stats screen.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase trophy page; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
1. Launch stunt jumps found across the map.
2. Land 250 unique stunts.
3. Track your total on the stats screen.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Sample every activity type—races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation, bowling.
2. Try each one at least once.
3. Unlocks after the final type is tried.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Visit each shooting range location.
2. Earn a gold medal in every shooting challenge.
3. Replay challenges to improve your scores.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. Find every Top Fun drone race location.
2. Win the drone race at each one.
3. The trophy unlocks after the last win.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
1. Enter races at different venues across Leonida.
2. Win 20 different races.
3. Count distinct track wins on the stats screen.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. Accept the fishing challenge from Cal.
2. Beat Cal's score in the challenge.
3. Unlocks with the win.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. Visit an arcade machine in the world.
2. Play a game to completion.
3. Trophy unlocks when you finish one arcade game.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
1. Take on Andy's stranger missions until his strand closes.
2. Complete his final mission.
3. Unlocks on completion.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
1. Work Kenton's mission strand.
2. Complete his final mission.
3. Trophy pops at the end.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
1. Follow Billy's stranger missions.
2. Complete his final mission.
3. Unlocks on completion.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Take missions from strangers marked on the map.
2. Finish 8 full mission strands.
3. Each strand's final mission counts toward the total.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
1. Help Randy through his mission strand.
2. Complete his final mission.
3. Trophy unlocks at the end.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
1. Work Tyrone's stranger missions.
2. Complete his final mission.
3. Unlocks on completion.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Locate meditation spots dotted across Leonida.
2. Meditate at every spot.
3. The trophy unlocks after the last spot.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
1. Accept Bret's hunting request.
2. Hunt the unique animal he marks.
3. Return to Bret to complete the job.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
1. Collect cards across the map.
2. Complete any 3 full card sets.
3. Unlocks when the third set is finished.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
1. Find WAiNK signs at 100 locations.
2. Interact with each one.
3. Trophy pops at the 100th location.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
1. Attempt the challenges listed on the pause menu.
2. Complete 50 distinct challenges.
3. Unlocks after the 50th.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
2. Evade the police long enough to lose the stars.
3. The trophy unlocks once the heat is gone.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob a shop with your partner.
2. Rob two more shops without being busted between them.
3. Keep the wanted level from dropping to escape.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
1. Drive or steal different vehicles across the map.
2. Discover 100 unique vehicles.
3. Vehicle list appears in the stats screen.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Activate Combat Focus in a gunfight.
2. Take down 5 enemies within the single activation.
3. Unlocks if the streak lands in time.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Reach VCIA airport.
2. Hijack a plane for an unscheduled departure.
3. Leave before security stops you.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Find and steal a Rhino tank.
2. Get inside and drive it.
3. The trophy unlocks when you first pilot it.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. Approach a jewelry store quietly.
2. Rob it without triggering alarms or being seen.
3. Disable security and escape undetected.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
1. Locate bank vaults on the map.
2. Rob and escape from 5 bank vaults.
3. Each successful vault escape counts once.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Find an armored truck out on the streets.
2. Rob it and get away.
3. Unlocks once you escape.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
1. Drive through every district of Leonida.
2. Uncover the whole map.
3. The trophy unlocks when all areas are revealed.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. Identify the illegal operations of each gang.
2. Rob one operation per gang.
3. Unlocks after the last gang is hit.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. Head to the Ocean Beach boardwalk at dusk.
2. Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar.
3. Sit back and enjoy the view.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
1. Enter a vehicle showroom.
2. Smash a vehicle out of the display.
3. Drive off through the glass in style.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
2. Bowl a frame.
3. Follow through on the throw to unlock.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
1. Gain a partner and build your relationship meter.
2. Reach the highest partnership level.
3. Unlocks when you max out the bond.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
1. Make story dialogue and decision choices.
2. Let the consequences play out.
3. The trophy unlocks at a scripted story beat.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
1. Fail a scripted story attempt.
2. Retry the mission.
3. Unlocks when the second attempt succeeds.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
1. Follow the story to the stranger finale mission.
2. Complete the mission's bizarre objectives.
3. Trophy pops when the mission ends.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. Get behind the wheel of a car.
2. Drive by pedestrians while leaning out in melee.
3. Knock down an enemy with the strike.
Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; official PSN description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn Marked Bills from contacts.
2. Launder $250,000 through your contacts.
3. Track the laundered total on the stats screen.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
1. Visit shops across Leonida.
2. Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops.
3. Unlocks when the total is reached.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
1. Save up for garage properties.
2. Purchase all garage properties on the map.
3. The trophy unlocks after the last purchase.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Kaeru collectible guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. Open the Scooter Bros app.
2. Register 10 different vehicles to it.
3. Unlocks after the 10th registration.
Sources: Exophase trophy page; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide.
